facts: Bathocyroe fosteri is a species of lobate ctenophore found at intermediate depths in all the world's oceans.
The species is very common and abundant near the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.
It is bioluminescent, and is typically observed hanging motionlessly in an upright or inverted posture although it can flap its oral lobes to swim.
